Game Overview

In Pumpkin In A Dark World, the core idea is straightforward: guide a resilient pumpkin through a shadowy, rain-laden world filled with perilous obstacles like spikes and rocks. With simple one-tap controls and an eerie atmosphere, timing becomes your best ally in this engaging quest to outlast darkness and achieve high scores.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Pumpkin In A Dark World is easy to pick up. Guide a resilient pumpkin through a shadowy, rain-laden world filled with perilous obstacles like spikes and rocks.
